name: Ophfane
description: Ophfane burns at the edge of charted space, its light reaching survey scopes long before any hull. Resonant chains lock the middle planets into a slow stately dance visible over decades. Salvage crews swear the comets arrive in formation, and the math almost agrees.

stars.name: Twin Crown
stars.description: A supergiant of 9.521 solar masses, strong stellar winds against the dark. It sheds mass in great slow gusts that feed the local nebula. Every chart in the arm uses it as a bearing star, willing or not.

planets.name: Ironmere
planets.description: Cracked highlands sprawl beneath a thin sky, every crater a kept record. Mining cuts stripe the equator where the crust proved thinnest. A standing bounty covers any intact core sample from the second planet outward.

moons.name: Rust Crag V
moons.description: A battered companion keeping patient orbit through the ages. Tidal stress warms its interior, and frost cracks map the strain. Outgassing vents frost the trailing face a little more each orbit.

moons.name: Frost Scree IV
moons.description: A battered companion keeping patient orbit through the ages. Its surface records every era of bombardment the system ever knew. Shepherd resonances with the rings betray a denser core than expected.

planets.name: The Kiln deep
planets.description: Banded clouds race around a deep crushing interior of metallic hydrogen. Storm ovals larger than worlds spin for centuries without fading. Something in the belt reflects too regularly, and the guild pays for a second look.

dwarfPlanets.name: Glass Lesser 60
dwarfPlanets.description: A small cold world holding its round shape against the dark. Frost plains stretch unbroken to a horizon that curves too soon. Its thin story is written entirely in impact craters.

asteroids.name: Basalt 477
asteroids.description: A tumbling rock with a scarred face and a patient spin. Its regolith hides metal concentrations the assays prize. Outgassing cracks suggest ice beneath the dust mantle.

belts.name: Frost Band
belts.description: Countless fragments grind slowly against each other in a broad torus. Collisional dust hazes the lane, and larger bodies keep eccentric courts. Old mining claims dot the denser knots, most of them long expired.
